name: SnagRootFan
collider: trunk + 3-5 main roots as convex hulls (Bark); Moss/Props share them; Plants (sedge, moss drips) no collider
pivot: bottom centre (lowest root tip at z=0)
notes: roots run below the water line; place with water at water_line_z
